en: We made it! C'mon, let's go set the bait!
We placed the dish upwind from{SAUT}the carnivore...
I hope the dinosaur can smell it...
Hraaaaah! Let the scent of meat reach{SAUT}your nostrils, mighty beast!{SAUT}*blow* *blow* *blow*
Uh, just blowing on the bait with your{SAUT}mouth isn't gonna work from this far―
Wha―The dinosaur's sniffing the air!
Whoa, seriously!?
Look! It's going for it!
Yes! It's eating the bait! We did it!
Should we use this opportunity to slip{SAUT}past it?
Hold up. It's about to finish off the bait.
Already!? All that effort, for nothing...
Wait, what the―it just wandered off?
It may well have returned to its nest{SAUT}now that it's had a meal.
Well, it seems like it all worked out{SAUT}in the end, right?
You know it! That carnivore's long{SAUT}gone!
Geez, now it feels like it was a waste to{SAUT}let that dinosaur eat our meat.
I agree. The opportunity to feast upon{SAUT}a cut of meat that size comes only once{SAUT}in a lifetime!
Let's try to get some more.{OPTION}Are there any leftovers?
Yeah! It was really fun to gather{SAUT}ingredients and cook with everyone.
But, gathering those ingredients again{SAUT}could very well put our lives in danger...
I imagine there's at least some meat{SAUT}juice left. I'll go check―
Oh no you don't. Mind your manners.
Oh, we still have tons of that sauce left!{SAUT}It's healthy and tasty―should we bring{SAUT}it back to the theater as a gift?
I wonder if we could serve this at our{SAUT}inn... I might be able to make something{SAUT}similar with conventional ingredients.
Would you forget the sauce!? What are{SAUT}you trying to do anyway, make a jungle{SAUT}version of Mystery Food X!?
What's Mystery Food X?
It's... You don't want to know.
Sorry to interrupt the conversation, but{SAUT}we don't know when that carnivore{SAUT}might return.
Ooh, he's right. C'mon, we'd better get{SAUT}through here as quick as we can!
